title: Automorphic commutator relations in relative geometric Langlands
summary: We prove the automorphic commutator relation conjectured by Liu and Wang arXiv:2504.00275, which is the geometric input for the automorphic Clifford relations in their framework relating higher period integrals to higher derivatives of $L$-functions over function fields. The relation was previously established only under additional cohomological vanishing assumptions and for curves of genus different from one; we remove these assumptions.
